newsitem.title: UK: TIGHT MED OIL PRODUCTS SUPPLIES KEEP LEVELS HIGH.
newsitem.headline: TIGHT MED OIL PRODUCTS SUPPLIES KEEP LEVELS HIGH.

text.p: Mediterranean oil products were quiet on Friday but tight supplies were keeping the levels of gasoline, gas oil, heating oil and fuel oil relatively high.
The Med gasoline market remained very tight as refiners continued to struggle to meet high demand. An open NWE-Med arb indicated Med cargo levels at least $2 above NWE quotes.
Little end-user interest was seen for naphtha, and dealers saw little prospects of an early opening in the arb to the East.
Gas oil was knocked lower by IPE futures shaving $3.00 off August values, but dealers said the Med was fundamentally firm.
"There is very little Russian except one prompt cargo which will go to Greece," said one trader. Notional prices for Russian was around high cif +$3.50, possibly a touch stronger.
Italian heating oil has been mostly sold out for August with just one 35kt cargo still available. Levels have been around high cif quotes +$3-3.50.
High sulphur fuel cargoes remain tight and traders said that the arb was open to the Med from northern Europe. A major refiner was said to be looking for some material.
"Cargoes can easily move down from the north to the Med market, which is quiet dry," a trader said.
Traders said that two ISAB stems reported earlier to be on offer in the Med may actually not be there.

One percent was quiet, but some suppliers were reported to be stocking up on material awaiting a major buyer to re-enter the market actively after its August holiday. --London newsroom, +44 171 5452 8145
